course_description:
Qualitative and quantitative research methods and their application in applied contexts are covered. Enables students to develop their research methods knowledge and skills, as well as develop science communication skills for both academic and practitioner audiences.

The course will provide a brief overview of research methods in applied psychology and focus on specific topics of relevance to the design and implementation of research in organisational settings. More specifically, the course should assist students in the consideration of methodological (i.e. measurement and design) issues related to applied research projects, as well as how to best communicate about these issues with both academic and practitioner audiences.

course_aims: The aims of this course are to a) gain an understanding of the process involved in conducting research within organisational settings, b) gain an understanding of the measurement and design issues associated with quantitative and qualitative research methods which are applicable to organisational settings, and c) gain an appreciation of how to “sell” a research project to stakeholder groups (in the form of an oral research proposal).

learning_outcomes.description: Critically evaluate contemporary scientific evidence and research methodologies relevant to organisational psychology research and practice.

Design and apply appropriate research methodologies — including experimental, quasi-experimental, survey, qualitative, and quantitative approaches — to investigate problems within organisational settings.
Select and justify measurement strategies and analytic approaches appropriate to applied organisational research questions, taking into account sampling, design, and contextual considerations.
Demonstrate effective collaboration and teamwork skills when addressing complex organisational problems.

Communicate research evidence and methodological approaches effectively in oral formats to relevant stakeholder groups, applying ethical reasoning and contextually appropriate language in applied organisational research contexts.

assessment_details.title: Group Case Study Research Proposal
assessment_details.due_date: 8/10/2026 10:00 am Students will present during the scheduled class time.
assessment_details.task_description: In groups of 5-6 deliver an oral presentation in the form of a research proposal on the organisational problem outlined in the case study provided (worth 30 marks). You will imagine that the lecturer and other students are the stakeholders who will decide whether or not to fund your proposed research project. Therefore, you are required to communicate the background research, unique focus, and proposed methodology of your project in a manner appropriate for your stakeholder group (e.g., community group members, school principal and teachers, company director, or a senior management team, etc., depending on the case study assigned). You will also be required to complete peer assessment on your other group members after the presentations (worth 10 marks). Read full task description Hide full task description

learning_activities.topic: Workshop 1: Introductions and Science for Research and Practice Course overview, an introduction to scientific methods, and ethical considerations in applied research. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03, L04, L05
Workshop 2: Designing Applied Research 1 Research models for science and practice, science communication, and different research designs. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03, L04, L05
Workshop 3: Designing Applied Research 2 Sampling theory and measurement issues, design decisions, and data collection methods. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03, L04, L05
Workshop 4: Analytic Strategies Qualitative and Quantitative Analytical Methods (including multilevel research). Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03, L04, L05
Workshop 5: Group Research Proposals Due (40%) Students present their case study analysis and research proposals within their groups in class, in person. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03, L04, L05
Workshop 6: Example Case Study Analysis Bringing it altogether - a course overview, a practice case study analysis, and assignment consultation. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03, L04, L05
